fortigate_fortios_7.content:
#config-version=FG60E-7.0.5-FW-build0304-220412:opmode=0:vdom=0:user=admin
#conf_file_ver=14728514937201
#buildno=0304
#global_vdom=1
config system global
    set hostname "CORP-FW-01"
    set timezone 04
    set admintimeout 45
    set admin-sport 8443
    set admin-ssh-port 22
    set admin-telnet enable
    set pre-login-banner enable
end
config system admin
    edit "admin"
        set trusthost1 192.168.1.0 255.255.255.0
        set accprofile "super_admin"
        set vdom "root"
        set password ENC AK1b578c93...
    next
end
config system snmp community
    edit 1
        set name "public"
        config hosts
            edit 1
                set ip 192.168.1.0 255.255.255.0
            next
        end
    next
end
config log syslogd setting
    set status disable
    set server ""
end
config system ntp
    set ntpsync enable
    set type custom
    config ntpserver
        edit 1
            set server "pool.ntp.org"
        next
    end
end
config firewall policy
    edit 1
        set name "Allow-Corp-Outbound"
        set srcintf "internal"
        set dstintf "wan1"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set logtraffic all
    next
    edit 2
        set name "Inbound-DMZ"
        set srcintf "wan1"
        set dstintf "dmz"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "Web_VIP"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "HTTPS"
        set logtraffic all
    next
end

arista_eos_switch.content:
! Arista EOS 4.28.1F Switch Configuration
!
transceiver qsfp default-mode 4x10G
!
hostname DC2-LEAF-01
ip domain-name cloud.internal
!
spanning-tree mode mstp
!
no aaa root
!
username admin privilege 15 role network-admin secret sha512 $6$rounds=500000$salt$hash...
username auditor privilege 1 role network-operator secret sha512 $6$rounds=500000$salt$hash2...
!
management api http-commands
   no shutdown
   protocol https
   no protocol http
!
management ssh
   idle-timeout 15
   authentication mode password
   no shutdown
!
snmp-server community internal-mon-ro view all-view ro
snmp-server location Rack-12-DC2
!
logging host 10.50.10.10
logging level notifications
!
ntp server 10.50.1.1 prefer
!
banner login
Authorized Access Only. All network sessions are recorded and subject to DISA STIG compliance.
EOF
!
interface Ethernet1
   description Uplink to Spine-01
   no switchport
   ip address 10.0.0.1/31
!
interface Ethernet2
   description Unused Port
   shutdown
!

  sys-serial-number "NX92-SN-99882211"
